environment: tsci_ready.json; adapted R 4.4.2, not the historical R 4.3.1 session

execution.process_group_after_exit: No remaining process in the owned R process group; author PSOCK workers terminated. No inference server was started.

inspection.method: Read the same saved author objects with inspect_tsci.R; no refit, source execution, candidate score or model referee.

display_comparison.method: Same stored fits, native R signif(..., 4) and exact numeric/count equality against the pre-execution published values. B-spline cells use native per-column format(..., digits=7). The nonliteral secondstage n_splits encoding discrepancy is separately printed, not silently counted as a passing expected field.

inspection.printed_numerical_agreement: The raw source output matches all inspected printed selected/per-space estimates, confidence intervals, p-values, validity/selection/strength counts and B-spline head values on paper pages 11-13 and 15 at their displayed precision. This is display agreement, not full-precision agreement with unavailable author objects.
inspection.frozen_metadata_error: The prospectively committed tsci_published_displays.json incorrectly inferred secondstage n_splits=1. The paper states no sample splitting but does not display that numeric field. The stored source object has nsplits=0. The frozen file remains unchanged; this is an operator encoding error, not a new tolerance, a source failure or an all-fields-pass claim.
inspection.split_raw_outputs: Five rows for each of three candidate estimates/standard errors and five selected estimates/standard errors, all 40 values finite. Internal worker condition histories are not fully exposed by the unchanged author parallel code; finite retained rows alone cannot prove zero internal failed attempts.
inspection.nonfinite_outputs: Four aggregate boosting standard-error NAs are reported as '-' by the source's FWER summary. The user-hat secondstage MSE is NA. No additional NA, NaN or infinity occurs in inspected numeric fit fields. The 3010-by-3010 supplied hat matrix is finite.
parent_warnings: RCurl and deSolve report builds under R 4.4.3.
The secondstage run warns that invalidity cannot be tested under weak instruments. Its printed non_testable count is 1; do not interpret it as established instrument validity.

data.missingness: Original missing counts: fatheduc 690, motheduc 353, KWW 47, IQ 949, married 7, libcrd14 13. Author mean-imputes the first two and adds indicators; unused remaining missing columns persist. No row deletion is hidden by the inspector.

qualification.rights: Journal package license verified; separate attachment redistribution remains unresolved. Source, package, data and output artifacts remain local and are not vendored.
qualification.use_boundary: A prospective replication task may use independently executed reference outputs. Freeze exact task, allowable sources, fresh computation checks, tolerance, family grouping and model/arm resources first. No theory acceptance or official publication result is granted here.
